parameters.name: AnycastId
parameters.description: The ID of the Anycast EIP.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the Anycast EIP.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the Anycast EIP.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length, and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eipanycast modify-anycast-eip-address-attribute --anycast-id aeip-bp1ix34fralt4ykf30000 --name docname --description docdesc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eipanycast ModifyAnycastEipAddressAttribute --region cn-hangzhou --Description docdesc --AnycastId 'aeip-bp1ix34fralt4ykf30000' --Name docname
